Class VerificationEngine

java.lang.Object
io.webagent4j.verification.VerificationEngine

  • Method Details

    • awaitAll

      public List<VerificationResult> awaitAll(IVerificationContext context, List<? extends IVerification> verifications, Duration timeout, Duration interval)
      Evaluates all conditions in encounter order, each independently allowed up to timeout.

      This is the original, still-supported contract: three conditions may together take up to 3 * timeout in the worst case, because each one starts its own fresh budget. Callers that must bound the total wait across every condition - an action's postconditions, for instance - should use awaitAll(IVerificationContext, List, WaitBudget, Duration) instead, passing one budget shared across the whole list.

    • awaitAll

      public List<VerificationResult> awaitAll(IVerificationContext context, List<? extends IVerification> verifications, WaitBudget budget, Duration interval)
      Evaluates all conditions in encounter order, passing the exact same WaitBudget instance to every one of them - no per-condition conversion to a remaining Duration and back into a new budget - so they share one shrinking deadline instead of each independently receiving a full, fresh timeout.

      If the first condition consumes most of budget, later conditions correspondingly see less of it in WaitBudget.remaining(); each one is still guaranteed at least one immediate probe, per WaitEngine's own "always probe once, even against an already expired budget" contract, rather than being skipped outright.
